newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BORO CHAIRMAN WILL QUIZ EMERSON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BORO CHAIRMAN WILL QUIZ EMERSON.

text.p: The chairman of premier league Middlesbrough will ask his Brazilian player Emerson about reports that he is unhappy at the club.

Emerson, who was expected to return to Middlesbrough later on Wednesday after a holiday in Brazil, is reported to have said he is unhappy in the English northeast and never wants to return to the club.
Now owner Steve Gibson wants to meet his four million pounds ($6.6 million) summer signing from Porto to see where he stands.
"I want a full explanation when he gets back," Gibson told reporters. "He signed a four-year contract. We offered him certain terms which he accepted and every one of those terms has been met."
Middlesbrough were reassured to learn on Tuesday that the other Brazilian midfielder on their books, Juninho, has no plans to leave the club.
"I don't know where these stories have come from about me leaving the club," he said.
"I am happy at Middlesbrough and I am pleased with the way things are going."
